extra.message: insecure_verify decodes the attacker-controlled JWT with verify=False and accepts it without validating its signature, issuer, expiration, or algorithm. The /get/<cust_id> endpoint uses this function, allowing authentication bypass.
The request JSON field search is interpolated directly into a SQL query and executed with db.engine.execute(). An authenticated attacker can alter the query to read or modify database data.

request.url is interpolated into the template source before render_template_string parses it. Attacker-controlled URL content can inject Jinja expressions into the template, potentially enabling server-side template injection and code execution through the 404 handler.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

extra.message: The exception string is interpolated into a template source before render_template_string parses it. SQL error content influenced by the attacker can inject Jinja syntax and potentially execute server-side template code.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code

extra.message: Uploaded YAML content is passed to yaml.load without a safe loader. A malicious YAML document can construct arbitrary Python objects and execute code during deserialization.

The authenticated /get/<cust_id> endpoint retrieves any customer record solely from the attacker-controlled ID and performs no ownership or role authorization check. Any user who obtains a token can enumerate customer records, including credit-card numbers.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: Customer responses include the unmasked credit-card number field ccn. The value is returned by both customer-fetching endpoints and is exposed to any caller who passes the endpoint's authentication checks.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: Application signing keys and the Flask session secret are hardcoded in source code. Anyone with repository access can forge JWTs or Flask session data.
The application automatically creates an admin account with the hardcoded credentials admin/admin123 when the database is empty. If deployed without changing them, the account is remotely guessable.
